name: Parallel Differentiable Rasterization
definition: A rasterization process that jointly renders HDR and LDR views using two parallel differentiable rasterizers ($F_{HDR}$ and $F_{LDR}$) fed by Gaussian point cloud parameters.
summary: Parallel Differentiable Rasterization renders HDR and LDR views simultaneously from 3D Gaussians by decoupling color into base and exposure-dependent values, avoiding tone-mapping artifacts.
